entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit. What the hell...
Did you find someone?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is that what it looks like?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This really ain't goin' our way...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All of 'em kept sayin' the same shit[n]Mishima was talkin' about!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Kamoshida had to have told 'em[n]something!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: At this rate... looks like we'll have to[n]go to him directly...
We should've started with that.
There's no point.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I know...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But seriously, isn't there something we[n]can do?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: No way I'm gonna give in like this!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Can you think of anything?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What do we do?
We should call the cops.
How about a sneak attack?
Let's punish the king.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So you wanna tell 'em about the castle?[n]They'd never believe us...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Have any other ideas?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That'd be fine if we could do it without[n]gettin' caught, but... if we did, we'd be[n]seriously done for.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You got any other ideas?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The king...? You mean that other world's[n]Kamoshida?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I didn't think of that, but...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is there any meaning to—

entries.speaker: Unknown Voice
entries.en: I finally found you...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...You say something?

entries.speaker: Black Cat
entries.en: Don't think you can get away with not[n]paying me back for helping you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That voice... Is that you, Morgana!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How dare you, up and leaving me[n]the other day!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The cat's talkin'!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I am NOT a cat! This is just what happened[n]when I came to this world!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It was a lot of trouble finding you two.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait... You came to our world!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Does that mean you've got a phone!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You don't need one when you're at[n]my level. I did get pretty lost making[n]my escape though...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That aside, why can you talk!?[n]You're a cat!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How should I know!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You hearin' this too?
Yeah.
We must be hallucinating.
Meow?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Then it really is Morgana...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I think we've both gone off the deep end.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This is no time to be jokin' around!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You guys are having a rough time of this,[n]hm? I heard you mention something[n]about witnesses.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, shuddup.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You know, I could tell you a thing or two[n]about what to do about Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You were pretty close just a moment ago.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: God, that condescendin' attitude![n]This thing's gotta be Morgana!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You were still doubting me!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ack! Quiet down!

entries.speaker: Disciplinary Committee Teacher
entries.en: We really have to be looking for a cat[n]in a busy time like this?

entries.speaker: Disciplinary Committee Member
entries.en: I just heard a meow somewhere near[n]here. Didn't you hear it?

entries.speaker: Disciplinary Committee Teacher
entries.en: Make sure you check every nook and[n]cranny around.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Meow?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Does that mean only us two can[n]understand what you're sayin'?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What the hell's goin' on?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways, what you were talkin' about[n]earlier... Is it for real?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're quite the skeptic for being an idiot.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, tell us more. Then again,[n]this probably ain't the best place...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Here, stick it in your bag for now![n]It should be just small enough to fit!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey! How dare you treat me like—
